New York: Brilliant Earth sold more engagement rings this quarter. It earned less on each one.

The San Francisco bridal retailer's third quarter reversed its spring pattern: orders rose 5.6% to 52,720, average order value fell 3.1% to $2,140. Net income turned positive, $2.4 million against a loss a year earlier. The outlook implies a roughly flat fourth quarter.
